title: ISO/TS 17165-2:2018 — Hydraulic fluid power — Hose assemblies — Part 2: Practices for hydraulic hose assemblies
version: ISO/TS 17165-2:2018, Edition 2; reviewed and confirmed in 2025; ISO/AWI 17165-2 subsequently registered for revision
locator: Official abstract and lifecycle: guidance for selection, routing, fabrication, installation, replacement, maintenance and storage for hydraulic hose assemblies using the listed hose and fitting standards.
notes: Practice guidance for hose assemblies, not a universal pressure or crimp specification. ISO/AWI 17165-2 is under development to replace the 2018 edition; check the contractually adopted edition and revision status. Do not mix hose/fitting/crimp equipment combinations without manufacturer compatibility evidence.
